newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CITIC sells HKTel stake to China E'bright.
newsitem.headline: CITIC sells HKTel stake to China E'bright.

text.p: CITIC Pacific Ltd said on Friday it had agreed in principle to sell 904.69 million shares, or a 7.74 percent stake, in Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd to China Everbright Holdings Co Ltd for about HK$11.4 billion in cash.
"It has been agreed in principle that the price will be calculated on the basis of HK$12.60 per Telecom share cum dividend," CITIC Pacific said in a statement.
After completion of the deal, CITIC Pacific said it would have no further interest in Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd.
It said the agreement had been reached on Thursday night but cautioned that negotiations were still proceeding and no agreement had yet been signed.
"No agreement has yet been signed and there is no guarantee that the discussions will result in an agreement," CITIC Pacific said.
China Everbright Holdings is the controlling shareholder of China Everbright International Ltd.
Trading in shares of Hongkong Telecom and CITIC Pacific resumed on Friday afternoon after being suspended this morning.
Hongkong Telecom fell HK$0.40 to HK$14.60 after jumping to a high of HK$15.90. CITIC Pacific gained HK$0.50 to HK$44.00.
